meta.title: Mac Tools
meta.description: A local macOS toolbox panel: QQ-style screenshot capture (native region/window picker, crop, arrows, shapes, text, mosaic, highlighter), calculator, phone transfer (QR LAN page for text/files/images), clipboard, and a Status dashboard in the spirit of State (CPU, memory, disk, network, battery, system information, SMC temperatures and fans, process ranking, threshold alerts) with fan-speed control. Panel-only; it registers no agent tools.
